_help: HUD widget top-left positions in 1366x768 space. Sizes stay in code (they must match the art). qslotcap = the key cap offset inside a 32x32 quick slot cell (all sixteen cells draw the same: cap top-left, icon centered). The game windows (inventory, stat, skill, quest, settings) have their own file: layouts/panel-<name>.json. Keys may be omitted (keeps current value). DEBUG builds reload this file live on save; the file wins over dragged panels.
